facts.text: MTSU offers guaranteed freshman admission to applicants who complete recommended prep courses and have either a 3.0 GPA, an ACT of 22, or an SAT of 1100.

sources.title: Undergraduate – How to Apply - MTSU
sources.quote: For guaranteed admission, applicants must have completed the recommended college preparatory courses and must present one of the following: 3.0 GPA OR Minimum composite ACT score of 22 OR minimum SAT total score of 1100
